# Train a classifier on iris dataset
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
ds <- list(x=data.matrix(iris[1:4]),y=iris$Species)
fm <- nn_cell_scorer |>
  setup(
    optimizer = optim_adam,
    metrics = list(
      luz_metric_accuracy()
    ),
    loss = nn_multi_margin_loss(margin=1)
  ) |>
  set_hparams(colnames(ds$x),levels(ds$y)) |>
  set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=0,lr=0.001) |>
  fit(
    epoch = 300L,
    data = ds,
    valid_data = ds,
    accelerator = accelerator(cpu = TRUE),
    callbacks = list(
      luz_callback_lr_scheduler(lr_lambda,verbose=TRUE,function(epoch) {0.1^(((epoch * 4L) %/% 150L) %% 4L)}),
      luz_callback_prune("layer1.linear.weight",n=1,at_epoch=149L)
    )
  )
#luz_save(fm,"model.luz")
```


```{r}
plot(fm)
```


```{r, warning=FALSE}
#rec <- lr_finder(fm,ds,accelerator=accelerator(cpu = TRUE))
predict(fm,ds,accelerator = accelerator(cpu = TRUE))$max(dim=2)[[2]] |> 
  as_array() |>
  table(iris$Species)
```
